name: Mosaic Alerts
describe: KOT board system alerts: delayed-order banner, audio-disabled prompt, online/offline toast, Not Permitted login modal.

Shown over the KOT board when an order passes kot_alert_time, when browser audio is blocked, when connectivity changes, or when the session expires. Modes: light and rtl only; dark is not applicable (mosaic/src/index.css defines one light palette (:root only) and no dark: classes or .dark overrides, so the KDS has no dark theme).
